title: ドラゴンのバリエーション
lead: 西洋風・東洋風・幼いドラゴンなど、オリジナルデザインのドラゴン12点です。ポスター・ゲーム素材・アイコンに使えます。
subject_en: ORIGINAL dragon designs invented for this series, each ONE dragon centred, bold stylised shapes, thick dark outlines, saturated colours, strong silhouettes, dynamic poses. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a red western dragon breathing fire, wings spread
a long serpentine eastern dragon in green and gold coiling through clouds
a small baby dragon hatching from a cracked egg
an icy blue dragon with crystal spines
a yellow and violet dragon wrapped in lightning
a green dragon covered in moss and leaves resting on a branch
a teal sea dragon with fins and a long wavy body
a heavily armoured grey dragon with horns, standing guard
a dragon flying upward with wings fully open, seen from below
a close-up roaring dragon head with horns and fangs
a dark purple dragon with glowing yellow eyes and star-like scales
a golden dragon with a long mane, majestic pose
